label.zh: “AI相关事件”情势期间的每月事件
label.en: Monthly events during the "AI-Related Incidents" situation

note.zh: 情势期间每月最多抽出其中一个（random_events，common/situations/02_strategic_situations.txt:627-634）；每个事件各自有触发条件。
note.en: While the situation runs, at most one of these is drawn each month (random_events, common/situations/02_strategic_situations.txt:627-634); each has its own trigger.

note.zh: 机器起义者获胜（1200 → 1030）或被镇压（1205），互相替代。
note.en: The machine uprising wins (1200 -> 1030) or is crushed (1205); alternatives.

notes.zh: 评注：每十年（on_decade_pulse → syndaw.400）有30%（＋随机推迟至多500天）的概率检查 syndaw.401：机器人人口超过75或超过25%时，以2:1在“超频”窗口 syndaw.500 与直接开始情势 syndaw.545 之间选择。500 本身经 45/90 天的 501、502 逐步揭示原因，选项决定是否引向 545 的“一个问题”。
notes.en: Commentary: every decade (on_decade_pulse -> syndaw.400) there is a 30% chance (delayed by up to 500 days) to check syndaw.401: with more than 75 robot pops or more than 25% robot pops it picks 2:1 between the "Overclocking" window syndaw.500 and starting the situation directly via syndaw.545. The 500 line reveals the cause step by step through 501 and 502 (45/90 days); its options decide whether it leads to 545 "A Question".

scope.zh: 触发（十年脉冲与机器人人口门槛）、“一个问题”与情势、八个每月事件、两个专项、起义与战争结局均已核对。
scope.en: The trigger (decade pulse and robot-pop thresholds), "A Question" and the situation, the eight monthly events, the two projects, the uprising and the war outcomes were checked.

uncertain: The situation's progress rate, approach effects and the project costs were not simulated.
